items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine, Mrs. "Papa Jack" Laine and Johnny Wiggs Interview, 1959-02-27
items.q: That poor George, he cried, he cried on my shoulder like a baby. Oh, I love him. I tell you the truth. I love him. He was my baby.

ctx.x: too. I mean. I could never think, you know, with George. That poor George, he cried, he cried on my shoulder like a baby. Oh, I love him. I tell you the truth. I love him. He was my baby. He was my baby. He sure was my baby. All the time.
